prompt: HTML img sizes attribute source-size-value valid CSS functions
answer: In an HTML `` `sizes` attribute, a ``: - Must be a non-negative CSS ``. - Must not be a percentage. - May use CSS **math functions**. - Must not use other CSS functions.
